issues.reason: The activation trigger contract is grounded to the three named collision detections, but no exact transition from the required external source to the sub-machine exists. Therefore there is no carrier transition whose trigger set can realize the required relation; the absent activation carrier is the precise semantic gap.
issues.requirement_quote: This sub-machine becomes active when a possible frontend collision, rear-end collision or collision with pedestrian is detected.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The three internal initial transitions all carry the normalized collision_detected event, but they are not the required external activation transition and their trigger semantics do not distinguish the three named detections.
issues.title: Activation trigger set does not match

issues.basis: NL3; exact source inventory with three authored separators; canonical concurrent-region projection; closed FCSTM concurrent-region annotations and working-contract region mappings.
issues.expected: The active collision-avoidance mode must expose the author-defined orthogonal region structure for concurrent collision-control activation.
locus_names: orthogonal regions of the active mode
issues.observed: The closed composite contains four projected concurrent regions, with region 0 empty and regions 1 through 3 carrying F, R, and P; this does not match the three authored orthogonal partitions.
issues.reason: The author source establishes three orthogonal region partitions for the active collision-avoidance mode, but the closed model projects four regions, including an extra empty region before the three authored partitions. This is a scope-structure mismatch against the exact region obligation.
issues.requirement_quote: The orthogonal regions of the active mode of collision avoidance allow for concurrent activation different of collision avoidance controls.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The extra empty region may be a compiler projection artifact, but the supplied closure does not establish that it is semantically excluded from the closed model's region inventory.
issues.title: Region scope does not provide the required concurrent structure

issues.basis: NL2; source-to-model mapping for Collision_Avoidance_Active_Mode; W_INITIAL_UNCONDITIONAL_MISSING; initial-entry verification rows for transition:line:12, transition:line:14, and transition:line:16.
issues.expected: Collision_Avoidance_Active_Mode must have an unconditional owner-local default entry to an operating child.
issues.observed: All three owner-local initial transitions are triggered by collision_detected; the deterministic inspection fact reports one missing unconditional initial transition and the composite is unreachable from the top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The exact collision-avoidance composite has three owner-local initial edges, each carrying the collision_detected trigger, and deterministic facts state that an unconditional fallback entry is missing. This prevents the required operating sub-machine from being entered by a default owner-local edge.
issues.requirement_quote: This sub-machine becomes active when a possible frontend collision, rear-end collision or collision with pedestrian is detected.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The three conditional initial edges could be intended as event-driven entries, but the supplied deterministic owner-entry fact explicitly distinguishes them from the required unconditional default entry.
issues.title: Missing unconditional sub-machine entry

issues.basis: NL2 activation requirement; exact source-to-model mapping; inspection-equivalent reachability; verify check reachability:state:Collision_Avoidance_Active_Mode:line:5; root reachability list containing only the machine root and UnspecifiedInitial.
issues.expected: A path from the top-level initial entry must reach Collision_Avoidance_Active_Mode so the named collision responses can activate it.
issues.observed: The top-level initial entry reaches only UnspecifiedInitial; state:Collision_Avoidance_Active_Mode:line:5 is refuted as reachable from the initial entry.
issues.reason: The required active-mode sub-machine is present in the closed model but cannot be reached from the top-level initial entry. The root reaches UnspecifiedInitial, while Collision_Avoidance_Active_Mode and all of its descendants remain unreachable; therefore the required collision-response behavior has no reachable execution path.
issues.requirement_quote: This sub-machine becomes active when a possible frontend collision, rear-end collision or collision with pedestrian is detected.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The active-mode composite has internal initial edges and complete source mappings, but those local edges do not establish reachability from the model root.
issues.title: Collision-avoidance sub-machine is unreachable from the root

issues.basis: NL2 endpoint requirement; exact source inventory transitions tr_0001 through tr_0006; closed FCSTM transition inventory lines 12 through 17; working-contract source/model mapping.
issues.expected: A transition whose source is the active mode and whose target is this sub-machine must exist.

issues.reason: The source requires a transition from active mode into the collision-avoidance sub-machine, but the supplied closed transition inventory has no exact transition with active mode as source and the sub-machine as target. The available transitions are only internal initial edges to F, R, and P and their completion edges, so the precise target relation remains unbound rather than being replaced by a nearby initial edge.
issues.requirement_quote: This sub-machine becomes active when a possible frontend collision, rear-end collision or collision with pedestrian is detected.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The phrase could describe activation of the enclosing active-mode composite rather than a literal external transition, but the supplied contract explicitly types the obligation as a transition endpoint relation and the closed inventory does not expose such a relation.
